hero.title: Undergraduate Computer Engineering in Italy for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Pursue an English-taught Laurea in Computer Engineering in Italy at historic polytechnic universities, combining microelectronics, industrial automation, affordable public tuition, and regional DSU scholarship opportunities.

highlights.eligibility: Recognised academic qualification + English / Italian proficiency

overview: Italy's Northern industrial technology belt is celebrated for excellence in automotive electronics, industrial robotics, precision machinery, and aerospace systems. Studying undergraduate Computer Engineering (*Ingegneria Informatica*) in Italy offers Indian students rigorous engineering instruction focused on designing digital computing hardware and automated electronic control systems.

Leading Italian polytechnics—including Politecnico di Milano and Politecnico di Torino—offer English-taught 3-year Bachelor of Science (*Laurea*, 180 ECTS) programs in Computer and Electronic Engineering. The academic curriculum covers electrical circuits, digital systems design, computer architecture, microprocessors, and real-time software, with very accessible public tuition fees (€1,000 to €4,000/year) and widespread eligibility for need-based regional DSU scholarships.

Graduates obtain credentials recognized across the European Higher Education Area (EHEA), preparing them for international hardware engineering roles or direct continuation into advanced Master of Science (*Laurea Magistrale*) programs. Non-EU graduates who transition into qualifying employment can access Italian stay-back and work permit pathways under national immigration regulations.

sections.title: Why Study Computer Engineering Bachelors in Italy?

items: Computer engineering is a combination of computer science and the engineering principles that support hardware, software, networks and digital systems. In Italy there are multiple university routes for students interested in these areas.
Key reasons to consider Computer Engineering Bachelors in Italy include:
Technical education: Discover the basics of programming, computer systems, electronics and engineering.
Practical learning: Students may do laboratory exercises, coding assignments and technical projects, depending on the university.
Multiple specialisations: Courses and electives that are right for you to explore embedded systems, automation, computer networks, cybersecurity foundations and intelligent systems.
European academic exposure: Enjoy an international educational environment and find out more about exchange programs.
Further study options: A bachelor's degree can be a stepping stone to related master's programs, depending on their entry requirements.
Potential financial assistance: Eligible students may explore university scholarships, local benefits and tuition discounts.
Students planning to study Computer Engineering Bachelors in Italy should compare the curriculum, teaching language, admission test, tuition fees and accommodation costs before choosing a university.
There are a few related undergrad avenues in Italian universities. Computer engineering and computer science aren't always the same degree, though they may overlap.
Computer Engineering
Computer engineering in Italy typically combines programming and computing with computer architecture, digital electronics, operating systems, networks and hardware-related engineering.
Possible subjects include:
Programming and algorithms
Calculus and linear algebra
Computer architecture
Digital logic
Operating systems
Computer networks
Electronics
Embedded systems
Software engineering fundamentals
Computer Science and Engineering
This pathway may include software development, algorithms, computing theory and engineering type problem solving. The precise balance will depend on the curriculum of the university.
Information Technology Engineering
IT engineering can be oriented toward computer systems, communication networks, information systems, software technologies, and digital infrastructure.
Related Specialisations
Students may also explore undergraduate programmes related to:
Artificial intelligence foundations
Cybersecurity fundamentals
Data science foundations
Robotics and automation
Electronics and communication systems
Embedded computing
Internet of Things technologies
These may be free-standing degrees, electives or subjects within a larger program. Students cannot assume that each specialization is available as a separate bachelor's degree.
When reviewing Computer Engineering Courses in Italy , check the official syllabus to determine whether the course emphasises software, hardware, electronics, mathematics or information systems.
Top Computer Engineering Universities in Italy

The following universities are good starting points for research into computer engineering and related undergraduate degrees. Always check the latest program page for language, admissions, places and fees.
Politecnico di Torino

Politecnico di Torino offers one bachelor's program in Computer Engineering, in the information technology engineering category. Language information Official program listed Italian and English listed Admission test compulsory 2026/27. Applicants should refer to the current course regulations for the language of teaching and any language requirements for their specific intake.
The computer engineering programs can include subjects such as programming, computing systems, electronics, networks and computer architecture.
Official programme page: https://www.polito.it/en/education/bachelor-s-degree-programmes/computer-engineering
University of Bologna

The University of Bologna provides a three-year bachelor program in Computer Engineering in Bologna campus. It is a 180 ECTS degree taught in Italian with limited admission through TOLC-I according to the 2026/27 program listing.
The university also offers a Computer Science and Engineering bachelor program at its Cesena campus. This program is also a three-year degree taught in Italian and has limited admission.
These courses are suitable for students who are looking for a combination of computing, mathematics and engineering principles.
Official programme catalogue: https://www.unibo.it/en/study
Politecnico di Milano
Politecnico di Milano offers a number of engineering bachelor's degrees and is worth a look for students with an interest in computing, electronics and digital technologies.

Applicants are required to distinguish a single-subject degree in Computer Engineering from related programs in information engineering, electronics or industrial engineering. Language of teaching and admission rules vary by program.
The university has formal admission requirements and entrance-test procedures for undergraduate engineering programs.
Official website: https://www.polimi.it/en/
University of Padua

University of Padua: undergrad degrees in engineering and science. Students can look at its information engineering and related technical tracks to see if the curriculum matches their interest in computer systems, electronics or software-related engineering.
For the actual program name, language of instruction, admission requirements and availability for international applicants, please refer to the official degree catalog.
Official website: https://www.unipd.it/en/
How to Compare Universities
Before choosing a university, compare:
Exact title of the degree and curriculum Language of instruction: Italian or English
Entrance exams and selection criteria
Eligibility for Indian 12th Class Qualifications
Bursaries and tuition fees
City, accommodation and living costs
Laboratory facilities and project possibilities
Postgraduate study options
Not every university offers a dedicated Computer Engineering bachelor's degree in English. Confirm the language directly on the programme's official page.

sections.title: Eligibility for Computer Engineering Bachelors in Italy

items: Indian students must satisfy the academic and language requirements of their chosen university.
Academic Qualifications
Applicants generally need:
A recognized Higher Secondary School qualification of Class 12 or equivalent.
Education meeting the requirements for admission to the relevant Italian university.
Mathematics preparation and physics where required by the program.
The minimum grade level required by the college.
Extra academic evaluations needed for international applicants .

The university determines whether a foreign school qualification meets its admission requirements. In some cases, additional documentation, qualification verification or a recognised foundation pathway may be necessary.
Language Requirements
The required language depends on the course:
Italian-taught programmes: Italian proficiency is generally required, often at B2 level where specified.
English-taught programmes: An accepted English-language qualification or other recognised proof may be required.
Mixed-language programmes: Applicants must check the requirements for both the course and graduation.
Entrance Examinations
Some universities require a test such as TOLC-I or their own engineering admission test. Other accepted tests or exemptions may apply depending on the institution and current regulations.
Students planning to Study Computer Engineering Bachelors in Italy should check test registration dates, scoring rules and deadlines before submitting an application.

sections.title: Admission Requirements for Computer Engineering Bachelors in Italy

items: The admission process varies by university and programme, but commonly includes the following:
Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets or transcripts.
Secondary school leaving certificate.
Valid passport.
Entrance test score, if required.
Proof of English or Italian proficiency, as applicable.
Official translations of documents, where requested.
Documents required to verify the foreign qualification.
Online application form and any required application fee.
Additional forms or declarations specified by the university.
What Do Entrance Tests Assess?
Depending on the institution, the admission test may assess:
Mathematics
Logic and reasoning
Basic scientific knowledge
Problem-solving
Other topics in the official test syllabus
Students should prepare using the test provider's current syllabus rather than relying on general entrance-exam material.
Can Indian Students Apply After Class 12?

Yes. Indian students are eligible to apply if they fulfill the entry requirements of the university and the relevant language, examination and document requirements. Just having completed class 12 does not guarantee admission.

sections.title: Admission Process for Computer Engineering Bachelors in Italy

items: Students can generally follow these steps:
Choose your course: Decide whether you prefer computer engineering, computer science and engineering, information technology engineering or a related programme.
Shortlist universities: Compare course content, language, tuition and location.
Check eligibility: Confirm that your Class 12 qualification and school subjects meet the requirements.
Review entrance-test rules: Check which test is accepted, how to register and when results are required.
Prepare documents: Arrange transcripts, certificates, passport and language-test evidence, where applicable.
Submit the application: Complete the university's official application and required selection procedures.
Receive the admission decision: Follow instructions for acceptance and enrolment.
Complete international pre-enrolment, if required: Students who need a visa generally follow the applicable process through Universitaly.
Apply for a student visa: Submit the required documents to the competent Italian diplomatic mission. Admission does not guarantee visa approval.
Prepare for arrival: Arrange accommodation, insurance and other practical requirements before travelling.
Procedures and deadlines vary by university and academic year. Use the current official admission notice and visa instructions for your specific intake.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help students understand the application sequence and prepare a document checklist.
A bachelor's degree in computer engineering can provide a foundation for further education or technical employment. Professional requirements depend on the intended role and country.
Further study: Depending on the academic requirements of the program, graduates can apply for relevant master's programs.
Software and technology roles: Employers may test your programming ability, technical projects, problem-solving and communication.
Hardware and embedded systems: You may need to know about electronics, computer architecture and embedded programming.
Regulated professional activities: Certain professional titles or engineering activities may be subject to recognition or registration requirements in certain jurisdictions.
Employment in India: Check the requirements of the employer, role and the relevant authority.
Employment in Italy: Fluency in Italian may help with internships and workplace communication.
Students should verify that the qualification and curriculum match their academic and career goals before enrolling.

The exact checklist depends on the institution, applicant's qualification and visa procedure. Students should follow the official instructions for their chosen programme.

faq.question: Can Indian students study computer engineering in Italy after Class 12?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply if their school qualification is in accordance with the university's entry requirements and they meet the language, entrance-test and document requirements.

faq.question: Are computer engineering bachelor's degrees in Italy taught in English?
faq.answer: Some courses or programs may be taught in English, but a large number of undergraduate degrees in computer engineering are taught in Italian. Please check the official language requirements of the exact program before applying.

faq.question: What are the fees for computer engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: As a general estimate, tuition at public universities may range from approximately €900 to €4,000 per year, while private institutions may charge more. Actual fees depend on the university and applicable fee rules.

faq.question: Is an entrance exam required for computer engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Many programmes have an entrance test or selection process. The University of Bologna lists TOLC-I for its 2026/27 Computer Engineering bachelor's programme, while other institutions may have their own tests or accepted alternatives.

faq.question: What jobs can I pursue after completing a computer engineering bachelor's degree in Italy?
faq.answer: Depending on your skills and experience, possible paths include software development, systems support, network engineering, embedded systems, quality assurance and technical analysis. Some graduates also continue to a relevant master's degree.
